I am a Ph.D. student at The University of Southern Mississippi in the Research, Evaluation, Statistics, and Assessment (RESA) program. I am broadly interested in the intersection of psychometrics, education, and the philosophy of science. I believe that valid measurement is essential for responsible scientific and industrial progress, and I am committed to applying statistical and methodological expertise to improve measurement efforts across education, business, and medicine.
